description: Backend changes: Update slide_exporter.py prompt to include layout variation directives (lead/two-column/centered), text decoration (bold/emoji/quotes), custom theme (hanashite-pop), header/footer, and completion_feedback generation. Update handler.py to include completion_feedback in system prompt output format and enforce empty string for non-step-3. Update mock responses and types.
steps: 1. Update src/types/index.ts: Add completion_feedback field to SlideApiResponse interface (string type). Add completionFeedback to AppState interface. Add StructureVisualizerStep interface and Step_Guide/Question_Rationale message type constants.

2. Update lambda/slide_exporter.py: Replace the step==3 prompt with the full enhanced version from design.md that includes: (a) Layout Variation directives (lead for page 1, two-column for page 2, centered for page 3), (b) Text decoration instructions (bold, quotes, emoji), (c) hanashite-pop theme in frontmatter, (d) header/footer directives, (e) presentation_guide generation, (f) NEW completion_feedback generation instructions.

3. Update lambda/handler.py _build_system_prompt(): Add completion_feedback to the output JSON format specification. Add enforcement logic: if current_step != 3, set slide_response['completion_feedback'] = ''. If current_step == 3 and completion_feedback not in response, set it to empty string.
4. Update src/mocks/mockResponses.ts: Add completion_feedback field to all 3 mock responses. Step 1 and 2 get empty string. Step 3 gets the full mock feedback text from design.md.
5. Update src/services/slideApiService.ts if needed (the response type change via types/index.ts should suffice).
6. Update existing lambda tests if they reference the old slide_exporter prompt format, to ensure they still pass with the new prompt content.
acceptance_criteria: slide_exporter.py step==3 prompt includes layout variation directives (lead, two-column, centered)
slide_exporter.py step==3 prompt includes text decoration (bold, quotes, emoji)
slide_exporter.py step==3 prompt includes theme: hanashite-pop and header/footer
slide_exporter.py step==3 prompt includes completion_feedback generation instructions
handler.py output JSON format includes completion_feedback field
handler.py enforces completion_feedback empty string for step != 3
Mock responses include completion_feedback for all steps (empty for 1,2; non-empty for 3)
All existing frontend tests still pass
Lambda tests pass (92+ pass, pre-existing 9 failures acceptable)
